Name: Mine Lava Lake Fish
Author: WhyBother11
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50088/50088-1794850663-711013460.png[/img][/center]
This mod introduces:
[list]
[*]five additional fish on floor 100;[/*]
[*]three additional items;[/*]
[*]one special order and one quest;[/*]
[*]one custom buff.[/*]
[/list]Here's full breakdown:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Five new fish, including a new legendary fish. Four of them can be caught on floor 100 of Mines with legendary one requiring fishing on floor 100 of Dangerous mines after you receive a quest from Willy and use a special bait. They have custom fish pond data and aquarium sprites.[/*]
[*]The new legendary fish (Giant lava Eel) can be caught after you complete Qi's Special Order to reach 120th floor of Dangerous Mines and have 10 levels in fishing skill. The next day Willy will send you a letter with recipe for special bait to catch legendary fish that will also add a quest to catch it. Then the Giant lava Eel will be available at any time and day at floor 100 of Mines while its dangerous mode is active. Attach a special bait and fish but be warned that it won't be an easy catch.[/*]
[*]Three additional items: Fire Essence, Fire Resistance Drink and Giant lava Eel Bait. Fire Essence can be gathered from new fish ponds or dropped by magma sprites. Fire Resistance Drink recipe can be learned after completing new special order and seeing special order completion event on the Farm. It grants a special buff. Giant lava Eel Bait is used to catch this new legendary fish.[/*]
[*]One new special order: Lava Lake Fish Research. Help Demetrius in researching fish from the lava lake and achieve a scientific breakthrough.[/*]
[*]One new buff: Fire Resistance. Halves incoming fire damage from monsters (currently includes damage from any attacks by magma sprites and sparkers, fire projectiles from lava lurks and squid kids, fire breathing attack of Pepper Rexes), prevents 'Burnt' debuff from magma sprites and sparkers.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*](Should be) Compatible with any mod, including expansions and fishing mods.[/*]
[*]Has built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul[/url] (all item prices are adjusted accordingly).[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50188]Fishing Log[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33167]Fish Helper UI[/url] will not recognize added fish as the floor 100 fish. They may display fish location as WhyBother11.MTE_MineLavaLake due to specifics of implementations.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8970]Fishing Info Overlays[/url] will show the fish only if its config value BarExtraCheckFrequency is > 0, as in this case it simulates fishing, not just takes location data which is not applicable to floor 100.[/*]
[*]Fish is shown with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url].
[/*]
[/list][size=5]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55229]Misc Things Extended[/url].[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42603]Moby Dick[/url].[/*]
[*](Optionally) Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game config menu.[/*]
[*]Download the mod and extract it into StardewValley/Mods. [/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/WhyBother11/MineLavaLakeFish]Source code[/url]
[size=5]Translations[/size]
Currently includes English and Russian translations (both will be kept up to date with any updates). All additional translations are welcome, so long as they contain only i18n files, here they are:

[/list]
